question: Khelo India Youth Games was formerly known as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khelo India School Games.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Khelo India Youth Games:-**

 
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is a multi-disciplinary grass-roots competition held annually in India.
 
• **Khelo India Youth Games was formerly known as the Khelo India School Games.**
 
• **It was renamed in 2019 to include college students, as well as school students.**
 
• It is a part of the Khelo India initiative, which was launched by the Government of India in 2017 to revive India's sporting culture and identify and nurture talented young athletes.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is open to athletes under the age of 17 for school students and under the age of 21 for college students.
 
• Participants compete in a variety of sports, including athletics, aquatics, archery, badminton, basketball, boxing, cycling, fencing, gymnastics, hockey, judo, kabaddi, karate, kho-kho, lawn tennis, shooting, table tennis, taekwondo, volleyball, weightlifting, wrestling, and yogasana.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Khelo India Jeeto India:-**

 
 
• It is a national sports program launched by the Government of India in 2018.
 
• It aims to revive the sports culture in India and establish the country as a great sporting nation
